registration: Locked before Cycle 5 fixture generation and learner changes. C2-C4 holdouts are retrospective regressions, never new training data.
training: Frozen C4 labels plus a separately audited premise-only factorial curriculum; holdout combinations excluded from the latter. C4 prior overlap is reported separately.
policy: C5-strict: retain supported native negative proofs; positive local projections remain diagnostic, and incomplete global composition yields unknown.
induction: Experimental only. Generate a bounded candidate relation from training descriptors and measured populations, with no pre-supplied consequent rule; compare disabled and sham controls, report local and global effects separately.
